risks.note: Both the distillery and the IML business are described as disrupted by what management calls illegal methods and illegal interference by State Excise authorities - customers reluctant to lift material, retailers threatened with dire consequences and forced not to lift the IFB branded product. Representations to the Excise Commissioner have been pending since 2020 and further representation was made to the then Chief Minister. This is a structural regulatory-relationship risk that management says has already caused intermittent stoppage of production.
risks.risk: Dependence on, and alleged obstruction by, the West Bengal State Excise administration

risks.note: Several newly commissioned ethanol distilleries with dual ENA production facilities have intensified competition in the State. Distillery margins were hit by stiff price cuts in ENA and Ordinary Denatured Spirit, and the outlook section states the current financial year will be a year of challenges for the Alcohol business with margin likely impacted by excess supply, higher non-edible grain prices and lower ENA prices.
risks.risk: ENA / ODS overcapacity in West Bengal compressing distillery margins

risks.note: Prices of Distiller's Dried Grains with Soluble and carbon di-oxide have decreased because of excess supply from the new ethanol plants, removing a margin cushion that the distillery model relies on.
risks.risk: By-product price erosion (DDGS and carbon dioxide)

risks.note: The IML industry in Bengal grew only about 3% over the last 2 years because of frequent price increases by the Excise Department, with a further duty increase effective 1 December 2025. Management says the abnormal price increase has forced lower-income consumers to shift toward smaller pack sizes - a mix and volume risk driven entirely by a third party.
risks.risk: Excise duty escalation shrinking the IML consumer base

risks.note: The newly commissioned 25 KLPD ethanol plant was completed during the year but sales will only start in FY 26-27 and only once new tenders are floated by the Oil and Marketing Companies, so an installed asset earns nothing until an external process runs.
risks.risk: Ethanol revenue is gated on external tender timing

risks.note: Raw shrimp is unavailable in West Bengal for almost 6-7 months in a year and the processing unit is situated in West Bengal only, which management explicitly calls out as making the marine business more challenging - a combined input-availability and geographic-concentration risk.
risks.risk: Raw shrimp seasonality with single-location processing

risks.note: Shrimp exports from India to the USA, the largest destination for Indian exporters, faced severe challenge from US tariffs; the Company's own dependence on the USA is limited and its marine export still rose from ` 213 Crs. to ` 273 Crs. Geopolitical uncertainties have separately raised pricing volatility, ocean freight and delivery delays from non-availability of shipping lines.
risks.risk: US tariffs and geopolitical disruption to the shrimp export trade

risks.note: The newly acquired aqua feed business is expected to face severe challenge because significantly higher input prices could not be passed on to consumers, the Andhra Pradesh Government having disallowed shrimp feed price increases - a state-administered price cap sitting directly on the segment the Company has just bought into.
risks.risk: Aqua feed input costs cannot be passed on under Andhra Pradesh price control
